🛠️ Assembly

```

Assembly Instructions

  • Measure approximately 5 cm from the bottom of the bottle.
  • Cut the bottle horizontally; check by placing the ring that there is no gap.
  • Apply strong glue into the slot of the ring.
  • Insert the bottom part of the bottle into the slot of the ring and hold it in place for a few seconds.
```
